title: Credit Policy — One Open Summit Loan per Borrower and Exclusivity with the HECM
content:
**Policy.** A borrower may hold only 1 open Cedarline Summit Proprietary Reverse Mortgage loan, because each Summit loan is secured by the borrower's principal residence. A Summit loan is boarded only when the borrower holds no other Summit loan whose status is in its rescission period, active, draw period expired or due and payable. A Summit loan and a HECM are mutually exclusive on the same borrower: a first-lien Summit plan replaces any HECM at closing, and a Summit Second Lien sits only behind a forward first mortgage, never behind a HECM.

## What counts as an open Summit loan

The test is made against the company's own loan records for that borrower, as they stand before the new loan is boarded; what the borrower says about other loans is not the evidence. A Summit loan already on record for the same borrower blocks boarding when its status is one of the four below.

| Status of the other Summit loan on record for the borrower | Counts as open for this rule |
|---|---|
| In its rescission period | yes |
| Active | yes |
| Draw period expired | yes |
| Due and payable | yes |
| Rescinded | no |
| Paid in full | no |
| Liquidated | no |

The four open statuses are the complete list: a Summit loan that was rescinded, paid in full or liquidated is not an open loan and does not stand in the way of boarding under this rule.

## The HECM

- A Summit plan that takes a first lien replaces any HECM on the home at closing; the borrower does not hold the two together.
- The Summit Second Lien is placed only behind a forward first mortgage. It is never placed behind a HECM.

## Illustrations (hypothetical borrowers)

| Hypothetical record for the borrower | Effect on boarding a new Summit loan |
|---|---|
| One Summit Select Line loan, active | not boarded — an open Summit loan exists |
| One Summit Flex Fixed loan, due and payable | not boarded — an open Summit loan exists |
| One Summit Fixed Lump Sum loan, paid in full | this rule does not prevent boarding |
| One Summit Condo Line loan, rescinded | this rule does not prevent boarding |
| A HECM ahead of the home, Summit Second Lien sought | the Summit Second Lien is not placed behind a HECM |
